package main

import "strings"

// registrationValidNick: 1 to 16 chars, starts with a letter, then letters, digits, '_' or '-'.
func registrationValidNick(n string) bool {
	if len(n) < 1 || len(n) > 16 {
		return false
	}
	for i := 0; i < len(n); i++ {
		ch := n[i]
		letter := (ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z') || (ch >= 'A' && ch <= 'Z')
		if i == 0 {
			if !letter {
				return false
			}
			continue
		}
		if !letter && !(ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') && ch != '_' && ch != '-' {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

// registrationComplete sends the welcome once both NICK and USER are in.
func registrationComplete(s *Server, c *Client) {
	if c.Registered || c.Nick == "" || c.User == "" {
		return
	}
	c.Registered = true
	s.Reply(c, "001", "Welcome to freeq-lite "+c.Nick)
}

// registrationRename changes a registered client's nick and informs
// the user and everyone sharing a channel, each once.
func registrationRename(s *Server, c *Client, nn string) {
	oldPrefix := c.Prefix()
	oldKey := strings.ToLower(c.Nick)
	newKey := strings.ToLower(nn)
	if s.clients[oldKey] == c {
		delete(s.clients, oldKey)
	}
	s.clients[newKey] = c
	c.Nick = nn
	targets := map[*Client]bool{c: true}
	for name := range c.channels {
		ch := s.channels[name]
		if ch == nil {
			continue
		}
		for k, m := range ch.members {
			if m == c {
				delete(ch.members, k)
			}
		}
		ch.members[newKey] = c
		for _, m := range ch.members {
			targets[m] = true
		}
	}
	line := ":" + oldPrefix + " NICK " + nn
	for t := range targets {
		t.Send(line)
	}
}

func registrationNick(s *Server, c *Client, m Message) {
	if len(m.Params) < 1 || m.Params[0] == "" {
		s.Reply(c, "431", "No nickname given")
		return
	}
	nn := m.Params[0]
	if !registrationValidNick(nn) {
		c.Send(":" + serverName + " 432 * " + nn + " :Erroneous nickname")
		return
	}
	key := strings.ToLower(nn)
	if other, used := s.clients[key]; used && other != c {
		c.Send(":" + serverName + " 433 * " + nn + " :Nickname is already in use")
		return
	}
	if c.Registered {
		registrationRename(s, c, nn)
		return
	}
	if c.Nick != "" {
		old := strings.ToLower(c.Nick)
		if s.clients[old] == c {
			delete(s.clients, old)
		}
	}
	c.Nick = nn
	s.clients[key] = c
	registrationComplete(s, c)
}

func registrationUser(s *Server, c *Client, m Message) {
	if c.Registered {
		s.Reply(c, "462", "You may not reregister")
		return
	}
	if len(m.Params) < 4 {
		s.Reply(c, "461", "Not enough parameters")
		return
	}
	c.User = m.Params[0]
	registrationComplete(s, c)
}

func registrationInitBody() {
	handlers["NICK"] = registrationNick
	handlers["USER"] = registrationUser
}
